experimental_question: Can MDPAR schedule adaptive NONE/HIGH cognition with one bounded HIGH background worker, preserving work identity and separating scheduling/latency hiding from post-hoc capability and MDPAR structural authority?
worker_rationale: one serial foreground cognitive stream plus one serial HIGH background worker and an explicit queue; fixed prospectively to avoid backend-parallelism fishing
offline_trigger: deterministic structural rejection/insufficiency of NONE; no temporal deadline exists in this regime
online_boundary: C9 scheduling isolation excludes semantic foreground-background interaction to isolate scheduling; semantic re-entry and cross-task cognition may be evaluated separately in OFFLINE, while ONLINE additionally imposes deadlines, temporal authority, freshness, committed-action protection and embodiment causality

arms.ADAPTIVE_SEQUENTIAL: NONE -> gate -> if rejected HIGH -> gate -> next case
arms.ADAPTIVE_CONCURRENT: NONE -> gate -> if rejected queue HIGH background -> immediately continue foreground NONE stream; collect HIGH only after foreground exhaustion

ecological_control: independent ADAPTIVE_SEQUENTIAL arm; stochastic/provider differences are reported rather than treated as the sole causal estimate
gold_guardrail: gold/capability vectors are post-hoc only and never control escalation, queueing, collection or authority
structural_authority: MDPAR; concurrency does not turn StructuralMark, resonance or invariance into a quality score
compute_guardrail: latency hiding is not compute avoidance; raw provider usage is preserved separately
